description: Convert W3C design tokens (DTCG) JSON into code. Pass `tokens` (JSON text or object) and optionally `format` (css, tailwind or both; default both) and `prefix` (added to every CSS name). Reads $type and $value with group-level $type inheritance, {alias} references (kept as var() references in CSS, resolved for Tailwind), color as a string or color object, dimension and duration as strings or {value, unit}, fontFamily, fontWeight, number, cubicBezier, shadow (one layer or several), border, transition and typography (expanded to one variable per field). Also reads the older value and type keys. Names come from the path (color.brand.500 becomes --color-brand-500) unless the token carries a name from css_to_dtcg. Validation reports missing types, circular or dangling aliases, name collisions and every token that has no CSS form (gradients, strokeStyle objects, unknown types) with the reason.

prefix.description: Optional prefix for CSS variable names, e.g. ds gives --ds-color-brand.

tokens.description: W3C design tokens as JSON text or an object.

name: dtcg_to_css
title: Design tokens to CSS
